name: sep-plus
description: Improve the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy reading experience

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.zip:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
